title: Double-click checkout creates two orders and two payments
description: A shopper double-clicks Place Order. Two orders and two card charges appear for the same cart even though the client sent one idempotency key.
steps: Open checkout with a single widget in the cart
Rapidly submit place_order twice with that key
observed: Two orders and two payments are stored.
expected: Exactly one order and one payment for a given idempotency key.
